headline: OpenAI to Proceed with US Data Center Expansion Despite Democratic Sweep
summary: OpenAI will press ahead with its US data center expansion plans despite the Democratic midterm sweep raising concerns about tighter regulatory scrutiny on artificial intelligence facilities, CFO Sarah Friar said.
why: Massive capital expenditure plans for artificial intelligence infrastructure drive growth for semiconductor, energy, and data center real estate sectors.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure
impacts.why: Continued data center expansion supports sustained demand for hardware, power, and real estate.
